items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: Milton and I did the first. Nobody's never topped ours. He records everybody that comes over there... We were the first in '67.

ctx.x: ones that were left, went on back to Sherman because it was -- we were on a job where we were making about $55.00 a week, and that was a lot of money, you know. So we stayed out there.

So Milton went back to Dallas. So during the time -- I had been like playing tenor anyway, switching, you know, like that month he stayed up there. So I was playing his tenor. I didn't own a tenor, but I was playing his tenor, just in case. I says, "Well, when you leave -- I know you're going to leave, so when you leave, I'm just going to switch to this tenor and get me a tenor," I said, because I liked the way he played tenor. Herschel liked the way he played tenor, too. We used to listen to him, you know. He…
Are you and Herschel about the same age?
